_about: Which values CUORE trends across visits, which readings are comparable, and what each is compared against. Read by cuore/services/trends.py. Every number marked 'heuristic, adjustable' is a CUORE rule of thumb, not a Stelvio specification: edit it here. Nothing in this file is a measurement.

cusum.note: Textbook two-sided CUSUM defaults (slack 0.5 sd, decision limit 4 sd). A shift is flagged only if it is also at least the metric's min_change.

defaults.aggregate: median per calendar day (one point per day with a comparable reading, so a long session cannot outvote a short one)
defaults.untagged_vin_rule: A stored reading with no VIN is used only when every VIN ever recorded in this state directory is the one being viewed (a single-car workshop). Otherwise it is left out.

metrics.label: Battery voltage at rest
metrics.why: A battery that rests lower each visit is losing capacity or something draws current when the car is off.
metrics.condition_text: Engine not running (RPM 0, or voltage 13.0 V or lower) and no CUORE or MES activity for 2 hours before the reading, taken in the first 10 minutes of the visit. 'Quiet' is a proxy: the car may have been driven in between without CUORE connected.

limit.text: 12.0 V at rest (heuristic, adjustable; a rule of thumb, not a Stelvio specification)

metrics.label: Battery voltage, key on, engine off
metrics.why: Key-on voltage under the car's own loads drops sooner than resting voltage when the battery weakens.
metrics.condition_text: Engine not running (RPM 0, or voltage 13.0 V or lower) and not a rested reading. Loads vary between visits, so this is a coarse trend.

limit.text: 11.5 V, the lower end of CUORE's own battery gauge range (cuore/live/layouts.py)

metrics.label: Charging voltage, engine running
metrics.why: A falling charging voltage points at the alternator, its regulator, or the wiring before the battery warning light does.
metrics.condition_text: Engine running: RPM of 400 or more, or (when no RPM was recorded) voltage of 13.2 V or more. Readings that rely on the voltage alone cannot show a charging voltage that has already fallen below 13.2 V, so a failing alternator can hide from them; RPM-backed readings do not have this gap.

limit.text: 13.2 V while running (heuristic, adjustable; a rule of thumb, not a Stelvio specification)

metrics.label: Battery state of charge (IBS)
metrics.why: The battery sensor's own charge estimate; a state of charge that settles lower each visit means the battery is not being refilled.
metrics.condition_text: Engine not running (RPM 0, or voltage 13.0 V or lower in the same reading window).

limit.text: 60 % (heuristic, adjustable; a rule of thumb, not a Stelvio specification)

metrics.label: Long-term fuel trim at warm idle
metrics.why: A long-term trim creeping away from zero is the engine compensating for a slow air or fuel problem, usually long before a trim code sets.
metrics.condition_text: Idle and warm: RPM 400 to 1100, speed 0, coolant 80 C or more, all recorded in the same reading window.

limit.text: plus or minus 15 % (heuristic, adjustable; not the ECM's own set-code threshold, which CUORE does not know)

metrics.label: Short-term fuel trim at warm idle
metrics.why: Short-term trim moves fast, so only its daily median is trended; a persistent offset at idle suggests a leak or a weak sensor.
metrics.condition_text: Idle and warm: RPM 400 to 1100, speed 0, coolant 80 C or more, all recorded in the same reading window.

metrics.label: Engine oil level (sensor DID 0x3A41)
metrics.why: Oil level falling between visits is consumption or a leak; this is the car's own sensor, not a dipstick.
metrics.condition_text: Engine not running and oil temperature 60 C or lower in the same reading window (a hot, just-stopped engine reads low: 4.17 L hot against 5.31 L cool was seen on this car).

limit.text: dipstick MIN mark = capacity minus the dipstick MIN-to-MAX volume (heuristic, adjustable; that volume is an unmeasured assumption in mes/oil_level.py, and the sensor-to-litres scale is unverified)

metrics.label: Time for coolant to warm from cold to 80 C
metrics.why: A warm-up that takes longer each cold start can mean a thermostat stuck open; this is drift only, there is no limit.
metrics.condition_text: A CUORE recording that starts with coolant at or below 40 C and reaches 80 C.

mode06.mid_note: 3A-3D are the EVAP leak monitors (3A and 3C answer on this car); A1-A5 are misfire counters. Only MIDs the ECM actually answered appear.
mode06.limit_source: The test's own Mode 06 minimum and maximum from the latest stored reply. A bound of 0 for the minimum or 65535 for the maximum is the 'no limit' placeholder and is ignored.
